prompt: Create one compact Japanese Lighthouse search-results scope/display header on pure white. Native wording, ORIGINAL fine-control anatomy. This component excludes unrelated source global workspace/logo/notification chrome. Top label exact 'すべての項目' Meiryo Regular14/24 dark. Below a single compact toolbar, naturally fitting approx390px at design scale: three source-style rounded pills 'すべて' / '対応中' / '保留', all Regular14/24, ONLY すべて selected with thin forest-green outline and green text, white or extremely local faint tint; other two white with thin neutral outline/dark text. Preserve original all/active/backlog state, no bold selected label. Immediately after pills restore original small add-view glyph omitted by mock: FILLED slate diamond with WHITE PLUS in center and separate shallow slate V/lower-layer edge just below diamond. Do not make generic plus-only button. At right restore original THREE circular white thin-neutral-outlined utility buttons: (1) FILTER exactly three centered horizontal lines decreasing top-to-bottom lengths, NOT funnel silhouette; (2) SETTINGS two horizontal strokes, upper hollow round knob left of center and lower hollow knob right of center, two knobs distinct; (3) LAYOUT small rounded rectangular outline containing a single SOLID vertical bar near RIGHT edge, NOT document lines. Source detail crops show exact anatomy. All small slate#526173 glyphs quiet optical size, glyph HEIGHT only1.0–1.15times body character height, circle buttons about28px role; do not oversize. Compact balanced gaps and consistent baseline, with enough flexible gap separating status group from utilities; reduce neutral pill side padding if needed to fit all controls, never omit any. Original circle/pill shape and precise glyph geometry take priority over mock square buttons/document substitutes. No broad mint, no card shadow, no phone chrome, no additional rows/content. White/neutral surfaces, no green utility glyphs. All exact Japanese text complete and readable; static raster only, no actual filter/view interactions.
reviewNotes: Exact add-view diamond/white-plus/lowerV, filter3descendinglines, two offset hollow settings knobs and rightbar layout glyph restored. Japanese Regular scope labels/allselected state correct. Three scope controls still rounded rectangles vs source full pill ends; targeted radius50percent correction only.
